programme.title: TED
programme.desc: TED delivers a jolt of creativity and inspiration. Watch the world's greatest thinkers and doers share ideas worth spreading.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1964)
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1964)
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1964)
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1964)
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1964)
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1964)
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1964)
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1964)
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1964)
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1964)
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1964)
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1964)
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1964)
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1964)
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1964)
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1965)
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1966)
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1964)
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1964)
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1964)
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1964)
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1964)
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1964)
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1964)
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1964)
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1964)
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family (1964)
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.desc: Join the United Nations Department of Global Communications live broadcast during UNGA81 from 21-25 September. Discover the transformations, innovations, and global solutions required to accelerate progress on the Sustainable Development Goals.

programme.title: Religions, Traditions, Cultures and Reproductive Health: Transformative Approaches, Innovative Transnational Partnerships, for more resilient health systems and the achievement of the SDGs in a complex humanitarian and security context

programme.title: Security Council Media Stakeout
programme.desc: 8:15am: Joint Statement from the six founding states of the Global Initiative on International Humanitarian Law. This includes: Ayman Safadi, Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs and Expatriates of The Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan Ambassador Mauro Vieira, Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Federal Republic of Brazil Jean-Noël Barrot, Minister for Europe and Foreign Affairs of France Mukhtar Tileuberdi, Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Kazakhstan Ronald O Lamola, Minister of International Relations and Cooperation of the Republic of South Africa Fu Cong, Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary and Permanent Representative of the People’s Republic of China to the United Nations Mirjana Spoljaric, President of the International Committee of the Red Cross ** 9:30am: Mr. Jean-Noël Barrot, Minister for Europe and Foreign Affairs of France on Artificial Intelligence ** 10:45am: Mr. Andrii Sybiha, Minister of Foreign Affairs of Ukraine, Mr. Jean-Noël Barrot, Minister for Europe and Foreign Affairs of France and Ms Kaja Kallas, EU High Representative for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy, on Ukraine

programme.title: 24th Meeting - 63rd Session of Human Rights Council
programme.desc: 63rd session of the Human Rights Council (07 September - 09 October 2026)

programme.title: (Day 2) General Debate - General Assembly: Plenary meeting, 81st session
programme.desc: The debate of the 81st session opens on Tuesday, 22 September, continues through Saturday, 26 September, and concludes on Monday, 28 September 2026. World leaders discuss global issues.

programme.title: AI and Human Development
programme.desc: Artificial intelligence is reshaping how we learn, work, connect, and belong. The ground beneath our collective life is shifting and with it come profound questions about human development, culture, community, and what it means to be human.

programme.title: OceanEye International Alliance: Stronger Together for Ocean Observation
programme.desc: The President of the European Commission, Ursula von der Leyen and Prime Minister of Canada, Mark Carney, in partnership with the Intergovernmental Oceanographic Commission of UNESCO (IOC-UNESCO) and the World Meteorological Organization (WMO) will host a High-Level Pledging Event for the OceanEye International Alliance: Stronger Together for Ocean Observation.

programme.title: Commemorating 75 Years of the 1951 Refugee Convention
programme.desc: For 75 years, the 1951 Refugee Convention has helped save lives, protect rights and provided a framework through which millions of refugees have found safety and rebuilt their lives. This high-level side event will seek to reaffirm that shared commitment and mobilize action and solidarity with and for refugees to uphold protection and expand solutions.

programme.title: (Part 1) High-level Meeting to Commemorate the 40th Anniversary of the Declaration on the Right to Development - General Assembly, 81st session
programme.desc: The commemoration of the 40th anniversary of the Declaration, presents a unique opportunity not only to mark a historic milestone, but also to reaffirm the right to development as a central framework for addressing contemporary global challenges and advancing a more inclusive, sustainable and equitable future for all, including by strengthening national policies and international cooperation consistent with the Declaration.

programme.title: Addressing the Global Inequality Crisis - A High-Level Event on an International Panel on Inequality
programme.desc: High-Level Side Event entitled "Addressing the Global Inequality Crisis - A High-Level Event on an International Panel on Inequality" on the margins of the 81st UN General Assembly High-Level Week, September 2026

programme.title: Maintenance of peace and security of Ukraine - Security Council, 10227th meeting
The Rohingya Crisis: A Renewed Call for a Durable Solution from Protracted Displacement, with Justice and Accountability
programme.desc: This High-Level Side Event, under the theme “The Rohingya Crisis: A Renewed Call for a Durable Solution from Protracted Displacement, with Justice and Accountability," will provide a platform for Member States, the United Nations, regional and international organizations, humanitarian partners and other stakeholders to reaffirm their collective commitment to addressing the Rohingya crisis.

programme.title: Highlights & Featured Content
programme.desc: Highlights of previous meetings and conferences, alongside pre-recorded curated videos from UN agencies showcasing the work of the UN in the field.

programme.title: Beyond Boundaries: Innovation, Discovery and Global Solutions | Goals Lounge
programme.desc: This session celebrates the excitement and wonder of exploring the universe and the power of science to inspire curiosity, creativity and innovation. From the awe of seeing Earth from space to the questions that spark scientific discovery, the conversation explores how the spirit of discovery expands our understanding of the world and encourages us to imagine a better future.

programme.title: Migration Capacity Partnerships for Resilience: Partners-Driven Cooperation in Times of Regional Instability
programme.desc: This side event examines how migration capacity partnerships can serve that purpose, drawing on two concrete experiences: the Migration Capacity Partnerships for the Mediterranean and the BRIDGE programme in the Jordan–Syria context. It takes place as States take forward implementation of the Global Compact for Safe, Orderly and Regular Migration and consider how the commitments in the Pact for the Future translate into practical cooperation on human mobility.

programme.title: Multiply Possibility High Level Event: A New Era for Education Financing
programme.desc: High level event co-hosted by the Permanent Mission of Italy and Nigeria to the United Nations and the Global Partnership for Education (GPE)

programme.title: Financing the Future: Mobilizing Public-Private Partnerships for Development
programme.desc: High-Level Event on "Financing the Future: Mobilizing Public-Private Partnerships for Development," jointly convened by the Kingdom of Morocco and UNDP.

programme.title: Fourth CVF Leaders Meeting on Development Reset and Cooperation
programme.desc: The Fourth CVF Leaders Meeting on Development Reset and Cooperation, led by Barbados Prime Minister H.E. Mia Amor Mottley as Chair of the Climate Vulnerable Forum, brings together heads of state and government, ministers, and senior officials from climate-vulnerable economies with development finance institutions and key partners. Convening amid heightened climate and economic uncertainty, and with the prospect of a Super El Niño intensifying risks to food security, water resources, public health, and fiscal stability, the meeting calls for a fundamental reset of the global development model.

programme.title: Human Rights for All - From Commitment to Collective Action
programme.desc: High-level conversation that aims to renew human rights as a compass for collective action, and bring together doers and thinkers from every region, sector and generation to co-create solutions, exchange ideas and build stronger partnerships.

programme.title: Accelerating universal health coverage for a more resilient world: the road to the 2027 high level meeting
programme.desc: Accelerating universal health coverage (UHC) for a more resilient world: the road to the 2027 high level meeting - Seventh annual ministerial meeting of the Group of Friends of Universal Health Coverage & Global Health. Co-hosted by the co-chairs of the Group of Friends of UHC & Global Health (Georgia, Japan and Thailand) and co-organized by WHO, UHC2030, and UN Foundation

programme.title: Call to Action for Palestinian Children in the West Bank and Gaza
programme.desc: To deliver on the humanitarian promises of UN Security Council Resolution 2803 towards children in Gaza and safeguard the future of children in the West Bank, including East Jerusalem, urgent action is needed to protect Palestinian children and address the deepening humanitarian crisis across the oPt.

programme.title: 30x30 Leaders Event: Accelerating Global Action to Protect 30% of Land and Ocean by 2030
programme.desc: Heads of State and Government will showcase progress toward protecting 30% of land and ocean by 2030, share solutions and strengthen political momentum and international cooperation ahead of the 2026 biodiversity conference.

programme.title: One Investment, Multiple Returns: Strengthening Child Health through Polio Eradication | Goals Lounge
programme.desc: Global health faces a defining moment, with countries navigating a shifting architecture of new threats, financing changes, and demands for stronger systems, while SDG progress remains uneven. The Global Polio Eradication Initiative exemplifies effective collective action, uniting governments, communities, donors, and multilateral organizations.

programme.title: High-level Event on Climate Action and the Just Transition - High-level Week 2026
programme.desc: The Secretary-General will convene a high-level meeting on climate action and the just transition focused on accelerating a just and orderly energy transition to renewables; mobilizing and scaling up affordable finance and investments for developing countries; and delivering adaptation and resilience support in an era of climate overshoot.

programme.title: OneSCD: A Global Partnership to Advance Equity and Transform Sickle Cell Care
programme.desc: OneSCD will be officially launched during the 81st session of the United Nations General Assembly (UNGA81) at United Nations Headquarters in New York. This high-level launch event will provide a global platform to mark a significant milestone in advancing the global response to Sickle Cell Disease (SCD).

programme.title: Humanitarian Diplomacy in Practice: Diplomacy as Enablers of Humanitarian Action
programme.desc: This session builds on previous discussions on Humanitarian Diplomacy series at UNGA 79, and 80, RIHF4 with an emphasis on how states, regional actors and humanitarian organizations can better align diplomatic engagement efforts with humanitarian priorities “on the ground” to secure access, protect civilians, and uphold humanitarian commitments across contexts—particularly in the Middle East and neighboring regions.

programme.title: Cultural Heritage at Stake: Addressing Looting, Illicit Trafficking and Restitution through International Law, Operational Cooperation and Cultural Diplomacy
programme.desc: The side event aims to highlight crucial issues, including the deliberate destruction of cultural sites, looting, and the illicit trafficking of cultural property, while providing an opportunity to examine these challenges further and identify effective solutions through an international conference to be held in Rome in 2027.

programme.title: G77 and Emerging Partners Ministerial Roundtable: “Addressing Technology-Facilitated Violence Against Women & Girls”
programme.desc: Technology facilitated violence against women and girls (TF VAWG)—including online harassment, non-consensual intimate image abuse, doxing, cyberstalking and AI enabled abuse— continues to increase in scale, reach and severity as digital technologies rapidly evolve, with profound impacts on women and girls’ safety, education, participation in public life, access to justice and economic empowerment.

programme.title: (Part 2) High-level Meeting to Commemorate the 40th Anniversary of the Declaration on the Right to Development - General Assembly, 81st session
programme.desc: The commemoration of the 40th anniversary of the Declaration, presents a unique opportunity not only to mark a historic milestone, but also to reaffirm the right to development as a central framework for addressing contemporary global challenges and advancing a more inclusive, sustainable and equitable future for all, including by strengthening national policies and international cooperation consistent with the Declaration.

programme.title: Artificial intelligence and international security - Security Council, 10228th meeting
programme.desc: Artificial intelligence and international security under the agenda "Maintenance of international peace and security"

programme.title: An Open Conversation On The Future Of Internationalism | Goals Lounge
programme.desc: Today, the world is more interconnected than ever. AI, climate change, migration, pandemics and financial instability all transcend borders. Yet the institutions designed to manage shared challenges face questions about their legitimacy and ability to act.

programme.title: Delivering on WPS: Consolidating Implementation and Accountability in a Fragmented Security Landscape
programme.desc: Building on the outcomes of the Rome meeting and previous meetings of the WPS-FPN, the Ministerial Meeting will aim to secure collective high-level political commitment to anchor the WPS agenda firmly within national institutions and multilateral processes, recognizing it as a global framework revitalizing multilateralism, building more inclusive and effective institutions, and advancing sustainable peace.

programme.title: Inaugural Meeting of Signatories to the Declaration for the Protection of Humanitarian Personnel
programme.desc: At High-Level Week 2026, the Ministerial Group for the Declaration for the Protection of Humanitarian Personnel will co-host an event marking one year since the launch of the Declaration. Ministers will highlight tangible actions they are taking that advance the objectives of the Declaration.

programme.title: The Fight Against Hunger and Poverty as a Foundation for Human Dignity and Sustainable Development
programme.desc: This event discusses accelerating SDGs 1 and 2 through international cooperation and financing, and renews political support for the Alliance's objectives.

programme.title: Highlights & Featured Content
programme.desc: Highlights of previous meetings and conferences, alongside pre-recorded curated videos from UN agencies showcasing the work of the UN in the field.

programme.title: Regional Stability, Security and Sustainable Return: Syria’s No-Camps Imperative
programme.desc: A high-level ministerial dialogue on advancing Syria’s transition from prolonged camp dependency towards safe, voluntary and sustainable return through recovery, services, livelihoods and investment.

programme.title: Highlights & Featured Content
programme.desc: Highlights of previous meetings and conferences, alongside pre-recorded curated videos from UN agencies showcasing the work of the UN in the field.

programme.desc: 63rd session of the Human Rights Council (07 September - 09 October 2026)

programme.title: Highlights & Featured Content
programme.desc: Highlights of previous meetings and conferences, alongside pre-recorded curated videos from UN agencies showcasing the work of the UN in the field.

programme.title: Healthy Indoor Air in Schools: Every Breath Shapes Learning
programme.desc: Co-sponsored by the Governments of Montenegro, France, and Eswatini this event will highlight one of the most overlooked levers in children's health and learning: the quality of the air they breathe in school. The event will spotlight indoor air quality across public health, education, biosecurity, and climate resilience and showcase Montenegro's national initiative on healthy indoor air in schools, alongside France and Eswatini's actions towards healthier indoor learning environments.

programme.title: Protecting Futures in Crisis: Building resilience through Education and Mental Health in Humanitarian Setting | Goals Lounge
programme.desc: Humanitarian crises are reshaping the lives of millions of children and young people, putting their education, mental health and futures at risk. This session will bring together global insights, frontline evidence and Member State leadership to explore how humanitarian responses can better protect learning, strengthen mental health and psychosocial support and drive lasting policy change.

programme.title: 26th Meeting - 63rd Session of Human Rights Council
programme.desc: 63rd session of the Human Rights Council (07 September - 09 October 2026)

programme.title: 593rd Meeting, 31st Session, Committee on Enforced Disappearances (CED)
programme.desc: Annual meeting with States and CSOs and event 20th anniversary of the Convention and closing of session

programme.title: (Day 3) General Debate - General Assembly: Plenary meeting, 81st session
programme.desc: The debate of the 81st session opens on Tuesday, 22 September, continues through Saturday, 26 September, and concludes on Monday, 28 September 2026. World leaders discuss global issues.

programme.title: (Part 1) High-level Plenary Meeting to Address the Existential Threats Posed by Sea-level Rise - General Assembly, 81st session
programme.desc: The High-Level Meeting on Sea Level Rise will convene global leaders, experts, and other stakeholders to address the urgent and escalating threat of rising sea levels. This meeting will focus on building common understanding, mobilizing political leadership, and promoting multisectoral and multi-stakeholder collaboration and international cooperation towards the objective of "addressing the threats posed by sea-level rise”.

programme.title: Governance, Technology and Trust in the Age of AI: The Role of Parliaments and Parliamentary Diplomacy in Countering Online Terrorist Narratives
programme.desc: The side event aims at fostering a high-level discussion on how Parliaments and parliamentary diplomacy can contribute to countering violent and terrorist narratives in the age of technological revolution, as part of broader prevention-oriented strategies that support social trust, democratic resilience, information integrity, international cooperation, and sustainable security.

programme.title: Shaping Democratic Agency over the course of AI Development
programme.desc: AI development moves fast. The challenge of harnessing AI's potential while governing its risks is vast - too large for any single country to address comprehensively with limited resources. Countries cannot wait for perfect international coordination, but neither can they afford duplication and fragmentation. This requires strategic choices: countries must invest in what they do best and then ensure that those diverse efforts - from research and standards to sectoral application to verification mechanisms - fit together as complementary parts of a coherent international governance framework.

programme.title: High-Level Ministerial Global Alliance for the Implementation of the Two-State Solution
programme.desc: The High-level Ministerial session will seize the opportunity to consolidate and further promote the above-mentioned international initiatives and to create concrete proposals to be operationalised during the coming year in order to foster their implementation.

programme.title: ECOSOC Ad Hoc Advisory Group on Haiti Ministerial-Level Meeting
programme.desc: Participants will discuss concrete avenues to support Haiti on its path to stability and development. Discussions will emphasize the leadership and accountability of Haitian authorities and stakeholders, with the international community playing a sustained supporting role. The event will take the form of a high-level panel, followed by a moderated discussion.

programme.title: (Day 4) SDG Media Zone – 81st Session of the UN General Assembly
programme.desc: Join the United Nations Department of Global Communications live broadcast during UNGA81 from 21-25 September. Discover the transformations, innovations, and global solutions required to accelerate progress on the Sustainable Development Goals.

programme.title: Security Council Media Stakeout: HE Dr. Abdullatif bin Rashid Al-Zayani, Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Kingdom of Bahrain on Maritime Security

programme.desc: The Media Stakeout would be attended by the following high-level officials: Saudi Arabia: Prince Faisal bin Farhan Al Saud European Union (High Representative): Kaja Espen Barth Eide Pakistan: Mohammad Ishaq Dar, Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Turkey: Hakan Fidan Egypt: Dr Badr Abdelatty, Minister of Foreign Affairs, Immigration and Egyptians Abroad Jordan: Ayman Al-Safadi, Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Spain: José Manuel Albares Ireland: Helen McEntee France: Jean-Noël Barrot GCC Participants Qatar: Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al-Thani, Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Kuwait: Sheikh Jarrah Jaber Al-Ahmad Al-Sabah Bahrain: Dr Abdullatif bin Rashid Al Zayani Oman: Sayyid Badr Al-Busaidi

programme.title: Demographic Resilience: Investing in Human Capital for Sustainable Futures
Delivering the Sendai Framework: An ASEAN Approach to Inclusive Disaster and Climate Resilience
programme.desc: The side event will explore key elements of an ASEAN approach to accelerate the implementation of the Sendai Framework, drawing on national and regional experiences to identify priorities for a future global disaster risk reduction agenda.

programme.title: From Commitment to Action: Integrating Midwifery into Primary Health Care to End Preventable Maternal and Newborn Deaths
programme.desc: The high-level side-event will champion national ownership of midwifery by embedding services within Primary Health Care as the foundation for scale, drawing on the Bangladesh–Sweden partnership and peer successes to demonstrate the impact of strategic workforce investments.

programme.title: Pandemic Prevention, Preparedness and Response and Human Mobility: From Global Commitments to Operational Action
programme.desc: The high-level event will provide a platform to spotlight how countries and partners are translating high-level commitments into operational action, and to invite renewed political engagement on migrant-inclusive, mobility-sensitive, whole-of-government and whole-of-society PPPR.

programme.title: Safeguarding UNRWA: Protecting Humanitarian Action and Upholding its General Assembly Mandate - Annual Ministerial Meeting in support of UNRWA
programme.desc: The Ministerial Meeting seeks to consolidate international political and financial support for UNRWA and to reaffirm the Agency’s role in carrying out the mandate entrusted to it by the United Nations General Assembly. The Meeting will explore concrete ways to safeguard the Agency’s ability to discharge its mandate, ensure the continuity of access to its lifesaving services to Palestine refugees, support the continued implementation of ongoing reforms, address its acute and immediate financial challenges, and respond to the political, legal and operational constraints affecting the implementation of its mandate.

programme.title: Taking Forward the Pact for the Future: Assessing Progress & The Road Ahead Two Years before the 2028 High-Level Review
programme.desc: As the international community approaches the midpoint between the adoption of the Pact for the Future (September 2024, Summit of the Future) and its review in September 2028, this High-Level & Civil Society 75-minute dialogue during UNGA High-Level Week will provide an opportunity to assess progress, identify implementation gaps, and raise ambition for the years ahead.

programme.title: From Playing Fields to Global Goals: Gender Equality in and through Sport | Goals Lounge
programme.desc: This Goals Lounge dialogue will explore how investing in gender equality in and through sport can drive social change, strengthen leadership pathways and challenge harmful norms. Bringing together leaders from sport, business, multilateral institutions and athlete advocacy, the session will examine solutions to keep girls in the game, expand opportunities and harness partnerships, investment and policy action to create more inclusive sporting environments.

programme.desc: Tracking the exotic pet trade of otters across the globe, is a story of gangsters and guns, mammals, and middlemen. programme.title: Epic Safari Encounters
programme.desc: Dardley joins Kristina at Ivory Lodge on the edge of Hwange National Park where her predator sightings just keep getting better. They get unbelievably close to wild cheetah and witness something incredible.

programme.title: Mega Nature
programme.desc: The largest animals are some of the most awe-inspiring, but when smaller species come together their combined forces can be even greater.

programme.title: Indochina's Wild Heart
programme.desc: Indochina three ancient kingdoms, Laos, Vietnam and Cambodia, linked by one great river: the mighty Mekong. A mystical land shaped by the forces of the monsoon. A region ravaged by war but, like a Phoenix, risen from the ashes. Within its boundaries can be found one tenth of the world's species, and some of the richest ecosystems on the planet. This is the land of the Mother River, one of the most bio diverse regions on Earth.

programme.title: Seasons of the Forest
programme.desc: No place on Earth is more changeable than the seasonal forest, undergoing radical transformations year after year. These adaptations to the seasons are what makes our woodlands so varied and dynamic a cycle of interwoven behaviors and practices ticking away like a Swiss watch to rejuvenate the landscape ready for the new year. To fully understand the stories of the great woodlands spend a year among the trees, watching the energetic and vibrant changes that mark the seasons of the forest.

programme.title: If There Was No Land On Earth
programme.desc: The third episode is a story about the rich cultural heritage and remarkable skill of the shipbuilders of Sulawesi told by an amazing local craftsman. We will watch as they construct and sail traditional wooden vessels that have been passed down through generations. We will follow the gripping story of the Carnatic, a British ship that wrecked on the coral reef in 1869, discover how the crew survived and how the treasure they carried was salvaged.

programme.title: If There Was No Land On Earth
programme.desc: Embark on an immersive journey through the heart of the Indo-Pacific as we explore the breathtaking coral reef ecosystem, home to an array of vibrant fish species and magnificent manta rays. Let's unearth the secrets of a prehistoric cave nestled within this underwater wonderland and marvel at the stunning beauty of the shoals of fish that dance around us. The vibrant colors and intricate details of this marine paradise offer a mesmerizing glimpse into the world beneath the waves that captivate with the majesty and wonder of the coral reef, as we witness nature at its most spectacular.

programme.title: History of Life on Earth Journey To The Land
programme.desc: As the first landmasses emerged from prehistoric seas, animals took their first steps on dry land. The explosion of life that followed changed the world forever.
